summary: Short kerb backing onto treed park verge, nearest home 25 m away.
reasons: Backs onto trees and grass verge

drivers.seclusion: Trees and a grass verge on this side; nearest dwelling 25 m away, others 29 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, with a grass verge beside the lane and a car already parked on it.
drivers.traffic: Short quiet spur close to a school street; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: A car parks here in the imagery; school no-stopping window 2-4 pm on school days.

flags: School no-stopping window 2-4 pm school days
Street is narrow, so the van may sit close to the lane
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades most of the section; morning sun from the east is partly blocked.

best_section.where: North side of the short curved spur, beside the treed park verge
